claims.head: Active D against forward-led
claims.body: On shots from defensemen, Anaheim is near the top of the league and Boston is one of the league’s worst. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
claims.gist: The Ducks and the Bruins sit at opposite ends for shots from defensemen.
claims.call: The Ducks’ defensemen take a bigger share of the team’s shot attempts than the Bruins’.
